evidence.title: GitHub - timDeHof/shadcn-timeline: Customizable and re-usable timeline component for you to use in your projects. Built on top of shadcn. · GitHub

name: Shadcn Timeline Component
summary: Customizable shadcn/ui timeline component with item statuses, icon colors, loading and error states and Framer Motion animations.
description: A copy-paste timeline component for shadcn/ui projects, split into Timeline, TimelineItem and TimelineTime. Items take a date, title, description, a custom icon and icon color, and a status of completed, in-progress or pending; sizes run sm, md and lg. It is ARIA accessible, SSR compatible with client-side date formatting, animated with Framer Motion, and documented in Storybook with a live demo. MIT licensed.
contains: item props: date, title, description, icon, iconColor, status, loading, error
statuses: completed, in-progress, pending; sizes sm/md/lg
ARIA accessible; SSR compatible with client-side date formatting
Framer Motion animations; loading and error states
Storybook documentation and a live demo at timdehof.github.io/shadcn-timeline
install by copy-paste; MIT licensed; 317 GitHub stars
